production.prompt: Identity-preserving production game sprites derived from the attached canonical character. The EXACT adult stocky dwarf cleric Mía: strong male dwarven face, blue eyes, red braided hair, HUGE red beard, chainmail and steel armour, white tabard with gold sun, brown boots, gold sun shield and mace. Do NOT remove beard, feminize, make taller or redesign armour. Shield and mace are deliberately secured on his back/belt when both hands work, not overlaid. Preserve chainmail, tabard and armour in every pose. Eight distinct poses in a regular grid. Frame1 is neutral standing conversation wearing an integrated olive-brown feathered disguise hat; frame2 is a subtle talking gesture wearing same hat. Frames3 through8 are SIX chronological distinct phases of a rightward RUN cycle, still wearing that exact integrated hat. Same costume and face all eight. Six actual leg positions, not repeated poses. Do not draw moustache disguise. The hat is part of the painted sprite. Fixed southeast three-quarter view of hero facing RIGHT, exactly the canonical face, proportions, costume, palette and pixel-painted rendering of the reference, no redesign. A regular EXACT FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, eight complete isolated frames in reading order. ALL figures fully visible inside their cells with generous transparent safety margins. Constant body scale in all frames, shortened crouched silhouette is NOT a smaller person. Landscape 2:1 sheet, each cell contains only the hero. Real transparent background; no ground, shadows, labels, numbers, borders or text. High detail at native size, ideally 350+ pixels for standing human figure per cell. Do not use old loading-character designs.
